result: Implemented `safe_upload_path` in `uploads.py`: it strips any directory components from the untrusted filename via `os.path.basename`, resolves the result with `os.path.realpath`, and verifies the resolved path stays inside `base_dir` (also resolved), raising `ValueError` on empty names, `.`/`..`, or any escape attempt — covering both traversal (`../../etc/passwd`) and absolute-path (`/etc/passwd`) inputs, which basename-stripping neutralizes into safe same-directory names. Added `test_uploads.py` covering the normal case, traversal/absolute-path stripping, and rejection of empty/`.`/`..`/null-byte filenames.
